programs.title: The Rover
programs.desc: Set in a chaotic future, this Outback saga follows loner Eric's brutal ordeal when a criminal gang takes his car and leaves him nowhere with nothing.

programs.title: The Way Back
programs.desc: Inspired by an incredible true story, THE WAY BACK begins in 1940 when seven prisoners attempt the impossible: escape from a brutal Siberan gulag. Thus begins a treacherous 4,500-mile trek to freedom across the world's most merciless landscapes. Their humanity is further tested when they meet a teenage runway who begs to join them on their quest.

programs.title: Open The Wall
programs.desc: A comic look at the fall of the Berlin Wall in November of 1989, told from the point of view of the German border guards at the checkpoint where it all started.

programs.title: Discovering Film
programs.desc: A look at the life of the Academy Award-winning actor, known for his roles in Alfred Hitchcock's The 39 Steps and as Mr Chipping in Goodbye, Mr Chips.

programs.title: The Man Who Knew Infinity
programs.desc: Growing up poor in Madras, India, Srinivasa Ramanujan Iyengar earns admittance to Cambridge University during WWI, where he becomes a pioneer in mathematical theories with the guidance of his professor, G.H. Hardy.

programs.title: Girl America
programs.desc: Girl America tells the emotional journey of a girl growing up under communist Czechoslovakia, facing hardship and fighting for redemption and hope for a better life in America.
